factions.name: Ranger
factions.description: Damage-dealer specializing in luck and nature items; starts with a Wooden Sword.

factions.name: Reaper
factions.description: Debuff, potion, and card specialist who thrives on poison, curses, and graveyard-style value.

factions.name: Berserker
factions.description: Melee bruiser that briefly enters a powerful Battle Rage/Super Mode once per fight.

factions.name: Pyromancer
factions.description: Generates Heat to reduce item cooldowns, fueling fire-based weapons and spells.

factions.name: Mage
factions.description: Casts and combines spells; specializes in books, buffs, and mana channeled through staves.

factions.name: Adventurer
factions.description: Flexible all-rounder that can specialize in Neutral items or draw from every other class's items.

factions.name: Engineer
factions.description: Charges items over time to enhance their effectiveness; gadget and gear focused.

factions.name: Witch
factions.description: Subclass unlocked via the pet Mr. Struggles; leans into debuff-reflection and permanent curses.

cards.name: Wooden Sword
cards.description: Basic starting melee weapon for the Ranger; also purchasable by other classes.

cards.name: Axe
cards.description: Berserker melee weapon that permanently grows stronger the longer the fight lasts.

cards.name: Double Axe
cards.description: Crafted from two Axes; a hard-hitting Berserker weapon that scales aggressively during Battle Rage.

cards.name: Falcon Blade
cards.description: Crafted from a Hero Sword and two Gloves of Haste; hits twice per activation and accelerates neighboring items.

cards.name: Broom
abilities: +2 damage per opponent miss before attacking
cards.description: Melee weapon favored by Witch builds that punishes an opponent's whiffed attacks.

cards.name: Staff of Fire
cards.description: Crafted from a Magic Staff (10g) and Draconic Orb (8g); a signature Pyromancer damage staff.

cards.name: Magic Staff
cards.description: Core Mage weapon used to cast and combine spells; base component of several staff upgrades.

cards.name: Pan
abilities: Bonus damage adjacent to food items
cards.description: Improvised weapon that hits harder when placed next to food, synergizing with food-heavy builds.

cards.name: Pandamonium
cards.description: Upgraded Pan crafted with a Corrupted Crystal; a legendary frying-pan weapon for food-synergy builds.

cards.name: Vampiric Gloves
cards.description: Crafted from Gloves of Haste (4g) and Blood Amulet (8g); accelerates neighbors and grants lifesteal.

cards.name: Heart Container
cards.description: Top-tier accessory available to all classes that raises maximum health.

cards.name: Cauldron
abilities: Brews a potion into an item slot in its row once per combat
Refreshes when an item in its column is destroyed
cards.description: Heavy Witch/Reaper accessory that auto-generates potions during battle.

cards.name: Health Potion
cards.description: Basic healing potion available in the shop for all classes.

cards.name: Mr. Struggles
abilities: 30% chance to reflect received debuffs onto opponent
Converts temporary debuffs into permanent ones
Below 50% HP: starred slots trigger 100% faster for 8s
cards.description: Round-8 exclusive pet that unlocks the Witch subclass for its main class and turns debuffs into a weapon.

cards.name: Wooden Buckler
cards.description: Entry-level shield offering modest defense for early-game builds.

cards.name: Gloves of Haste
cards.description: Cheap early accessory that accelerates neighboring items; a common crafting component for haste builds.

cards.name: Blood Amulet
cards.description: Reaper accessory granting lifesteal; commonly combined into Vampiric Gloves.

cards.name: Draconic Orb
cards.description: Fire-affinity accessory used as a crafting component for the Staff of Fire.

cards.name: Hero Sword
cards.description: Strong mid-tier melee weapon and key crafting component of the legendary Falcon Blade.

cards.name: Box of Riches
cards.description: Special accessory that expands the shop pool with gold- and gem-related items when placed in the bag.
